scope: Read-only independent narrow review of Cookie ingress frozen16 against existing canonical routes

confirmedFindings.classification: confirmed compilation blocker by lexical scope; no SDK performed
confirmedFindings.problem: runLoginJS(credentials:) passes loginOwner but that name exists only in other static method parameter scopes. No View member/local/captured definition exists.
confirmedFindings.suggestedIntegrationDelta: Use the actual shared LoginManager for this UI path or introduce the one explicit View owner consistently; preserve frozen history.

confirmedFindings.problem: Script set stores both legacyHeaders and rich records. A WK baseline followed by deletion removes matching rich/native records but leaves legacyHeaders. get falls back to the deleted raw value; nativeCookies also rehydrates it and the next launch can do the same. This does not require foreign storage mutation or an original rich Cookie CAS claim.
confirmedFindings.suggestedIntegrationDelta: When confirmed observed removals remove an accepted identity, also remove that old legacy text value without discarding unrelated domains/keys/accepted paths. Add same-owner get/header/new-owner restart deletion regression.

confirmedFindings.classification: confirmed pre-existing residual in an audited actual route, not newly introduced by frozen16
confirmedFindings.problem: sourceBrowserRequest automatically fills its actual browser/captcha Cookie header from broad legacy get. get intentionally supplements URL-visible cookies with all related-domain records, bypassing Path/Secure for this automatically generated network header. Source-authored explicit Cookie precedence is a separate behavior.
confirmedFindings.suggestedIntegrationDelta: Use the same owner RFC-aware requestHeader/nativeCookies only for this automatic jar fallback; preserve the explicit script get/getKey and authored Cookie contracts.

confirmedFindings.classification: confirmed new asynchronous lease identity gap
confirmedFindings.problem: The navigationResponse Cookie Task awaits owner IO without capturing/checking the current WebViewNavigationWait or lease generation. Cancellation releases and may reassign the same WKWebView. An old failure then removes/resumes the newer loadingMap entry and stops the newer navigation; old success can also set cookies/allow after reuse.
confirmedFindings.suggestedIntegrationDelta: Bind the Task to the captured wait/lease, validate after each await, and remove/stop only when the map still has that owner. Complete the old policy decision without mutating a new lease.

notFindings: The original runtime whole StoredCookie RFC/CAS snapshot is explicitly unsupported, not implemented by this ingress actor.
Cross LoginManager/source/cache/Cookie original transactions remain preflight unsupported; the existing UI sequence is not an atomic multi-owner transaction.
Foreign global HTTPCookieStorage automatic writers are not claimed to have a durable original Cookie CAS proof.
Unknown WK hostOnly/original origin are explicitly retained as unknown; no inferred provenance is accepted as proof.
reviewLimits: Read-only source reasoning and exact frozen SHA verification do not replace SDK compilation or owned HTTP/WebKit tests.
No real app Cookie file, user profile, private credentials, account, device, or external fixture endpoint was read.
A finding in frozen-v1 remains a historical finding even if a later independent work delta fixes it.
